title: Research: Risk Signal Engine v3 with explainable signals and walk-forward evaluation
head: research/risk-signal-engine-v3
body:
## Purpose
Detect stock-specific risk with HOLD/WATCH/REDUCE/CRITICAL even when VIX is low and historical support remains intact. This research-only module emits no allocation sizes or orders. Stacked on PR #3 (which contains PR #2); existing engines, weights and production services are unchanged.

## Implementation and data
Three transparent variants: A drawdown/trend, B confirmation across capped indicator families, C explanatory capped score. Publication-gated inputs, explicit DATA_UNAVAILABLE/STALE suppression, optional VIX/SOX quality, causal prior-high/support calculations and change reasons. Forward labels are isolated from signal inputs.

Frozen Yahoo AMD/NVDA/MU/QQQ/^SOX OHLCV and corporate-action responses, plus CBOE VIX; 2020 warmup, evaluation 2021–22 October 2026. Sources, retrieval times and SHA-256 hashes included. Daily CSV/full JSONL, event tables for all three stocks, future 5/10/20-session outcomes, regime diagnostics and training candidates are reproducible offline under reports/risk-signal-v3/.

## Walk-forward findings
Expanding training windows select from three frozen profiles using earlier-period labels only, followed by frozen annual tests in 2023–2026. Across 55 eligible >=10% excursions, A/B/C warnings preceded 10% in 14.5% / 12.7% / 61.8%; false-growth warning rates 54.2% / 49.1% / 54.8%. C median lead is one session and high-risk duty cycle 40.6%. Same-period fixed-balanced comparisons are exported separately. In the October peak-linked episodes C precedes 10% by two sessions for AMD, NVDA and MU. Training through 2025 nominates C/sensitive only for further research.

## Validation
Full suite: 104 tests passed plus 20 subtests. New v3 suite: 27 passed, repeated after final report generation. Offline regeneration completed: 21,717 daily records, 444 event rows, 933 entry outcomes and 12 frozen folds. All recorded code/output checksums and git whitespace checks passed; no failed automated checks.

## Risks and limits
Retrospective split-adjusted provider history is not an independently verified point-in-time publication archive. Availability timestamps are conservative assumptions, corporate-action data remain provider-dependent, and the catalogue was developed after history became observable. Walk-forward prevents computational label leakage, not retrospective research bias. Event/forward horizons are dependent; incomplete outcomes are censored. False alerts and late detection remain substantial: detection feasibility is demonstrated, reliable investment effectiveness is not. A fresh prospective holdout and verified historical vintages are required.

No merges, deployments, database changes, trading integration or modifications to existing v2/Decision Engine modules.

title: Research: economic backtest of frozen Risk Signal v3 with cash-limited recovery
head: research/risk-signal-v3-economic-backtest
body:
## Economic question and scope
Replay the unchanged PR #5 walk-forward C signals for AMD, NVDA and MU to test economic value against identical-cost Buy & Hold. The 2026 profile remains C/sensitive selected through 2025; earlier years use their original preceding-data fold configurations. No signal generation rules or thresholds are changed.

The execution/recovery protocol was frozen in commit 0190497 before calculating economic results. Principal size remains 10%, with no selection by 2026 profitability. This PR targets the PR #5 branch, not main.

## Execution and evaluation
- Initial independent capital $100,000; fractional original-share units, 50% share floor, no leverage/shorting/additional funds.
- One reduction per risk episode, one optional CRITICAL add-on; explicit rearming after three low-risk observations, no repeated daily selling, single pending order and next-open execution. CRITICAL-disabled controls isolate the first reduction.
- Fixed HOLD3 / TREND3 / TIME10 recovery policies; gradual FIFO buybacks bounded by spendable cash. Cash shortages preserve the share deficit.
- Commission and adverse slippage each 5 bps; delays 1/2/3 sessions. All 5/10/15/25% size combinations are exported without choosing a winner.
- Retrospective first confirmed closing trough, actual protection at that trough, matched realized contributions, separate open marks, missed growth/dividends and period-censored future labels. Troughs and future labels never enter the execution policy.
- Full continuous 2023–22 October 2026 accounts, independent 2023–2024/2025/2026/Sep–Oct controls, inherited-state subperiod slices and all 55 original significant drawdown episodes.

## Main findings: 10%, HOLD3, CRITICAL enabled
| Stock | Buy & Hold final NAV | Tactical final NAV | Max DD B&H / Tactical | Tactical minus B&H |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| AMD | $768,821.88 | $562,805.39 | 63.00% / 56.73% | -$206,016.49 |
| NVDA | $1,431,535.64 | $945,798.22 | 36.87% / 28.78% | -$485,737.42 |
| MU | $1,695,930.16 | $1,179,834.53 | 57.31% / 45.38% | -$516,095.63 |

All 18 full-period primary recovery/CRITICAL controls finish below Buy & Hold in this source vintage. Intermediate protection does not translate into higher terminal wealth: expensive re-entry, missed growth and residual share deficits dominate. October principal cycles remain open at the cutoff; their positive relative marks are not realized round-trip profit. Recovery choice and delay materially affect results; size scaling is nonlinear.

## Artifacts and validation
reports/risk-v3-economic/ includes report.md, all requested CSVs, full primary trades/daily equity/FIFO matches, signal and order audit trails, October tables, quality checks, immutable protocol, validation.md, hashes and equity/share-position/drawdown charts. Offline reproduction: python -m aae.research.risk_v3_economic_study. Optional plotting requirements are isolated from production dependencies.

Full repository suite: 133 tests passed plus 20 subtests, including 29 new economic tests. Final regeneration completed: 189 summary rows, 2,993 trades, 40,887 daily records, 330 event/policy protection rows and 234 sensitivity rows. Every primary/sensitivity ending NAV difference reconciles exactly to lot contributions. Source/output checksums, frozen-v3 hashes, account invariants and whitespace checks pass. No failed automated tests.

## Historical/accounting limitations
Inputs remain PR #5 retrospective provider vintages, not independently verified point-in-time archives. Raw OHLCV/actions, New York opens, adjusted split continuity and signal/price timestamps are checked, but independent corporate-action reconciliation and exchange-calendar completeness remain unresolved. One split-adjusted basis is used throughout; splits are not applied twice. Missing actual dividend payment dates require segregated non-spendable ex-date receivables; price-only controls are also exported. Taxes, interest, market impact and terminal liquidation are excluded.

Neither signal nor execution research is an untouched prospective holdout. These are conditional historical diagnostics, not proven investment effectiveness or a universal rejection of risk management. No merge, deploy, production data change or live investment recommendation is included.

title: Research: Risk Forecast v1 with purged walk-forward probabilities and dependent-window validation
head: research/risk-forecast-v1
body:
## Question and scope
Test whether unchanged Risk Signal v3 provides incremental information about future AMD/NVDA/MU price barriers. No sales, buybacks, position sizes or economic simulations. This PR is stacked on PR #6. Protocol 8b22cf4 was committed before calculating results; no REDUCE rules, bins, shrinkage or criteria were tuned on October outcomes.

## Chronological forecast design
- Frozen PR #5 data inherited through PR #6: 2021–22 October 2026; 2021–2022 training/descriptive, annual frozen probability tests in 2023–2026.
- Replay each original annual C profile on archived causal indicators for training; held-out levels/scores must match the original walk-forward outputs. 2026 remains C/sensitive.
- Fit at Jan 1 UTC using only anchors whose entire horizon has been published by that cutoff. Early barrier hits cannot admit an otherwise unfinished horizon. Exported maturity audits cover every fit.
- Targets: any future High/Low hitting +/-5/10/15% within 5/10/20 sessions, excluding the anchor candle. Separate terminal returns. Both directions may hit; first-hit chronology and same-day ambiguity/opening-gap ordering are explicit. Incomplete horizons retain partial observed bounds but null full-horizon labels.
- Eight fixed empirical models: historical, matched drawdown, matched volatility, MA50/RSI, v3 state, v3 score, joint technical, joint technical plus v3. Fixed shrinkage and LOW_SUPPORT/backoff flags; no test-based model selection.

## Dependence and inference
Calendar moving-block resampling keeps all stocks together on a sampled date, preserving overlapping windows/common shocks. 40-session blocks, 399 metric/calibration resamples, 1999 primary paired resamples; block20/60 and yearly sensitivity also exported. Metrics include Brier, log loss, tied-score ROC-AUC/noninterpolated AP, reliability, class counts, capped HAC effective N and confidence intervals.

Primary comparison: technical_plus_v3 versus technical_combined for all 18 tasks. Require Holm p<0.05 across 18, negative paired 95% Brier interval, >=1% relative Brier improvement and block-length stability. Other comparisons and score slopes remain exploratory.

## Findings
**0/18 primary tasks confirm incremental predictive advantage under the fixed criterion.** For DOWN10 within20, pooled held-out Brier scores are approximately historical 0.228, volatility 0.224, v3-state 0.231, v3-score 0.230, joint technical 0.230 and joint technical+v3 0.234 (lower is better). Added v3 has paired delta Brier +0.0046, 95% interval [+0.0017,+0.0074].

There are 2,805 reference-task observations but an effective N around 74. State frequencies are HOLD 28.7%, WATCH 31.6%, REDUCE 36.9%, CRITICAL 26.5%, with substantially overlapping block intervals. No DOWN task has a strictly positive exploratory 95% score-slope interval. This is not a monotonic forward-downside probability scale in the tested history.

Sparse conditioning matters: about 94% of reference joint-plus-v3 forecasts carry LOW_SUPPORT. These specific estimators fail to demonstrate added information; this does not prove every possible estimator lacks predictive content. First chronological error examples per stock, late-warning diagnostics and gradual-deterioration HOLD cases are included without inventing cases or treating every warning followed by growth as a proven error.

## Artifacts and validation
reports/risk-forecast-v1/ contains the requested report.md, forecast-daily.csv, calibration.csv, baseline-comparison.csv, event-analysis.csv and validation.md, plus fit audits, state/score/metric/year/block tables, outcome summaries, October censoring and reliability/distribution figures. 39,366 daily task rows, 216 frozen probability banks, 576 metric rows, 1,080 comparisons, 2,032 reliability bins and 1,447 diagnostic records. Reproduction: OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 python -m aae.research.risk_forecast_study.

Final suite: **160 tests passed, 20 subtests passed**, including 27 new forecast tests. No unresolved automated failures. Weighted/tied ROC/AP independently cross-checked against sklearn; final source/output hashes and whitespace checks pass. Exact-touch floating-point handling was corrected via scale-relative tolerance and outputs regenerated. Frozen v3 inputs and engine modules are unchanged.

## Limits
Retrospective split-adjusted prices and assumed publication times are not independently attested point-in-time vintages. Reported daily OHLC cannot reconstruct unobserved extended-hours paths. Bootstrap conditions on fitted models/history, does not include all training/model-design uncertainty and assumes imperfect regime stability. Sparse cells/rare events do not support precise confident live probabilities; irregular conditional subsets show block counts instead of invented effective N. No reserved prospective holdout, live readiness or investment-effectiveness claim.

No merge, deploy, production data changes or modifications to existing Risk Engine/Decision Engine/investment recommendations.

title: Research: Historical Drawdown Anatomy v1 with nested-free events and causal hypothesis validation
head: research/historical-drawdown-anatomy-v1
body:
## Research question
Catalogue historical technology-stock drawdowns first, then test whether prespecified precursors add predictive information beyond ordinary technical baselines. This PR targets PR #7. No trading strategy, signal changes, production integration, merge or deploy.

Definitions were frozen in protocol commit c8d0b6f before associations: observable-history closing highs, full prior-peak recovery, nested declines merged into one episode, fixed control sampling and H1–H5 thresholds. Future catalogue peaks/troughs never enter predictors.

## Data and event anatomy
Primary AMD/NVDA/MU plus all 15 requested additional names; 2021–22 October 2026 with 2020 warmup. Existing primary/QQQ/SOX/VIX packs are unchanged. Supplemental Yahoo OHLCV/actions and FRED DGS10 responses, retrieval timestamps, normalization/publication assumptions and hashes are frozen separately.

142 principal episodes, including 38 primary-stock episodes (AMD 8, NVDA 15, MU 15); 710 causal snapshots at -60/-40/-20/-10/-5 sessions. Closing threshold dates, troughs, depth/duration, genuine recovery, left truncation and unfinished episodes are retained. Sensitivity covers high/low extrema, 98% recovery and 12% inclusion, plus 360 per-definition hypothesis-coverage records.

Controls use every20th-session anchors, same stock/causal QQQ regime/two-year block, deterministic date-distance matching and explicit reuse weights. All mixed/censored cohort dates remain auditable. There are 1,314 cohort anchors and 5,792 matched/control records, including 921 NO_MATCH records. Some primary sideways cells have no eligible matches; no frequencies are fabricated. Matched controls are descriptive, never case-enriched probability-training samples.

## Predictive validation
2021–2022 discovery/training; frozen annual 2023–2026 probability models. Entire forecast horizons must be published by the training cutoff, including discovery-boundary purging. Fixed ridge1/training-only standardization; baselines historical frequency, RV20, DD60, relative strength, original v3 states and their joint model. Original primary v3 levels/scores match archived walk-forward values exactly.

Primary target: 10% loss from the current close within60 sessions; secondary20. Add one H1/H2/H3/H5 flag to the joint baseline. Paired synchronous120-session calendar blocks,1999 primary resamples, Holm across four testable hypotheses, >=1% relative Brier improvement, block60/120/180 and cross-stock consistency.

**0/4 testable primary hypotheses meet the full support criterion.** H4 cannot be tested without original EPS/guidance vintages. In 24 primary-stock episodes starting in 2023–2026, prespecified exposures occur before 17 (H1),15 (H2),19 (H3),8 (H5); these descriptive coverages do not translate into incremental forecast validation. Primary Brier deltas versus joint baseline: H1 +0.0020, H2 -0.0008, H3 +0.0010, H5 +0.0001; all paired intervals include zero, and expanded-group direction does not confirm improvement.

An additional forward-path-drawdown target was explicitly frozen in commit3d53761 AFTER first primary results but BEFORE its own calculation. It addresses a rally followed by a large drop that does not lose10% from the earlier anchor. It preserves all parameters and is labelled exploratory, not an independent confirmation or replacement target. Its primary/expanded comparisons also do not show incremental improvement. Future path peaks are target labels only.

## Artifacts and tests
All requested files under reports/historical-drawdown-anatomy/, plus control/fit/baseline/year/block/definition/target audits, missing-data.md and three figures. Large supplementary probability audits are deterministic gzip CSVs; required event/control tables are plain CSV.

Final full suite: **186 tests passed, 20 subtests passed**, including26 new anatomy tests. No unresolved automated failures. Source/raw/action consistency, split-unit invariance, causal prefixes, confirmed-low timing, horizon purging, unknown data, nonoverlap, maturity audits, compressed row counts and final hashes/whitespace checks pass. All 2,160 anchor/path model fits converge or use explicit class backoff; no nonconverged fits. Offline reproduction: OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 python -m aae.research.drawdown_anatomy_study.

## Limits and interpretation
This repeatedly studied historical period is research, not a pristine independent holdout. The universe consists of surviving companies; sector breadth is a fixed11-name proxy excluding the target, not historical whole-market membership. PLTR's shorter warmup is flagged. Observable-history highs start in2020, not verified lifetime ATHs.

Price/action/yield vintages and publication times are not independently attested original archives. Yield availability uses an assumed conservative two-session lag. EPS/revenue revisions, forward P/E, guidance/news vintages and market-wide breadth remain unavailable; current values are never substituted. Few120-session blocks, sparse exposures and reused controls limit precision. Recurrence, conditional association and incremental prediction are distinct. No confirmed investment effectiveness or live-readiness claim.

title: Risk Forecast v2 — Predictive Validation
head: research/risk-forecast-v2-predictive-validation
body:
## Результат

Risk Forecast v1 воспроизведён без изменения исходной модели. На отдельном, заранее зафиксированном benchmark не установлено преимущество primary estimator перед исторической, волатильностной и режимной базовыми вероятностями. Общий вывод: **RESEARCH ONLY**; для заявления об установленном преимуществе и live integration — **NO-GO**. Отсутствие значимости не доказывает отсутствие эффекта.

Это исследовательская оценка на реальных архивных котировках, но история уже использовалась в предыдущих исследованиях и не является нетронутой независимой выборкой. Исторические PIT vintages не аттестованы.

## Источники и зависимость веток

- Новая ветка: `research/risk-forecast-v2-predictive-validation`.
- PR основан на Draft #16 @ `848610ff46f125d5369f15852d5daceca53acafa`, чтобы сохранить актуальную базу знаний из #14 и последующие записи. Эта зависимость нужна для документации; данные PIT из #13–16 в расчётах не использованы.
- Код и входной пакет v1 воспроизводились в отдельном checkout PR #7 @ `366f8cd00e8c228d4796d0abbe9997f717a3b6ad`.
- Изучены и зафиксированы PR #8 @ `c228624158068db64fe7e487a5be59281448fcd9`, #11 @ `5d5092b5d03e16f03241c1b5a5d5a19c1816c9c7`, #12 @ `4f8e5615a1c4977b93558735da49c8b424de83ab`.
- На момент проверки #7/#8 открыты, #11/#12/#14/#16 — Draft; перечисленные исследования не merged и не считаются внедрёнными.
- Протокол опубликован **до вычислений**: commit `b1d43275bb10bc69516e868b625377ceea4119b6`, SHA256 файла зафиксирован и проверяется runner.

## Что рассчитано

Первый этап: неизменённый original runner дал все **13 CSV побайтно идентичными** опубликованным, включая прежний результат **0/18** primary successes. Только environment metadata/paths в run.json отличаются.

Второй этап: отдельно пересчитаны вероятности той же архитектуры/параметров на более строгих train/calibration/test windows. Эти новые estimates не выдаются за исходные опубликованные probabilities v1.

- AMD, NVDA, MU; 5/10/15% × 5/10/20 сессий; достижение по будущему Low и terminal Close оцениваются отдельно.
- Train только на прошлом, полная зрелость labels, 20-session purging/embargo, отдельная calibration диагностика без подбора mapping.
- Test years 2024–2026; 34 200 test task rows, включая обе семьи targets, — **не независимые события**.
- Brier/log loss, reliability и calibration curves, alerts при заранее заданных .5/.7, устойчивость по тикерам/годам/режимам.
- Парные сравнения на одних observations; synchronous date-block bootstrap 1999 повторов, блоки 20/40/60, Holm по 27 primary contrasts.
- Отдельная фиксированная экономическая диагностика one-share restoration с задержками 1/2 сессии, комиссиями и проскальзыванием; это не portfolio return и не оптимизация стратегии.

**Ни одно из 27 primary contrasts не прошло критерии; 0/9 TOUCH tasks подтвердили преимущество против всех трёх baselines.**

Пример: TOUCH 10% / 20 сессий, pooled n=1875 коррелированных stock/date anchors:

| Модель | Brier | Log loss |
|---|---:|---:|
| technical_plus_v3 | 0.237899 | 0.670022 |
| unconditional | 0.233308 | 0.659593 |
| volatility | 0.232776 | 0.658217 |
| QQQ regime | 0.226822 | 0.645385 |

Меньше — лучше. Delta Brier против unconditional +0.004591, 95% block CI [-0.005270, +0.014504]. В этом срезе 95.89% primary forecasts имеют LOW_SUPPORT. Интервалы широкие; пересекающиеся окна, связанные stocks и повторное использование истории ограничивают статистическую мощность и интерпретацию.
